title: Hand over your business
tagline: A fair price, a smooth handover and the proceeds working for the next chapter of your life.
trigger: Age 55+ with a long-running business, and payments to a valuation expert or a transfer lawyer.

steps.title: What your business is worth
steps.description: An independent valuation, based on years of invoices and cash flow KBC already sees.
steps.why: A buyer will do the same sum; knowing it first strengthens your position. Nothing is shared.
steps.result: Valuation report ready, based on your invoice history (illustrative range).

steps.title: Plan the handover
steps.description: To a family member, an employee or an outside buyer: the options, the timing and financing for the buyer.
steps.why: KBC can also finance the buyer, which often makes the deal possible.
steps.result: Handover plan ready: three scenarios with timing and tax impact (illustrative).

steps.title: Tax and legal set-up
steps.description: How the sale is taxed, and what to arrange in the company before it changes hands.
steps.why: The structure of the sale can matter more than the price.
steps.result: Tax and legal checklist ready for your accountant.

steps.title: The deed with a notary
steps.description: A notary from KBC's network prepares the transfer deed and checks the company's records.
steps.why: The notary only receives your name, e-mail and company details.
steps.result: Notary appointment set; the draft deed is in your digital vault.

steps.title: Put the proceeds to work
steps.description: Your private banker turns the sale into income for later: a Private Plan, investments and estate planning.
steps.why: Your private banker gets the file KBC already built, so you never start from zero.

win.customer: Your life's work becomes your pension

steps.result: Meeting booked with your private banker to plan the proceeds.
